_comment: GK-GAP-010 (tightened by R2-GK010-ASSERT): a public method's SigHashPreimage parameter counts as checked only where checkPreimage(p) is the asserted condition of assert(...), directly or as any conjunct of the top-level && chain inside it, on every path (spec/type-system.md 4.2-4.3). A discarded call, a call bound to a local, a negated, ||-ed, compared or ternary-wrapped call, a call used as an if / ternary condition and a helper that returns checkPreimage(p) check nothing. Refused cases carry the shared diagnostic; accepted cases must compile to the same bytes in every tier. A `return` ends its path: a private helper's asserted check counts only if it precedes every return (helper-*-return cases). A SigHashPreimage parameter is tracked wherever it sits in the parameter list (wide-params-* cases: 64 parameters precede it). A contract method named checkPreimage is not the built-in (method-named-checkpreimage). R3-GK010-GAPS + D9: ANY property that holds a SigHashPreimage (readonly or mutable, scalar or FixedArray element, stateless or stateful) is refused at its declaration with its own diagnostic (readonly-*property* and mutable-*property* cases): a readonly one is a constant in the locking script, a mutable one was written by an earlier spend, so either way it was fixed before the spending transaction existed, checkPreimage on it can never pass and every extractor read of it is unverified. The implicit txPreimage of StatefulSmartContract is not a declared property and is unaffected. A FixedArray<SigHashPreimage> method parameter is refused by every tier's validator (fixedarray-parameter; each tier words that diagnostic itself, so only the substring FixedArray is pinned).
